info.title: Learning Platform API
info.description:
All responses use `{ success, data, meta? }` or `{ success: false, message, errors? }`.

Authenticate with **POST /auth/login**: the session is an httpOnly cookie, which Swagger, Postman and browsers all keep automatically. Scripts may also send `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`.

E401.description: Not signed in, or the session is no longer valid

active.description: Hidden categories stay on existing courses

description.example: Build servers with Node.js and Express.

post.summary: Register as a student or instructor (instructors start pending)

201.description: Created; the session is set as the httpOnly `token` cookie

post.summary: Log in (the session is set as an httpOnly cookie, never returned in the body)

put.summary: Change your password (signs out every other session)

200.description: Changed; a fresh session cookie is set for this client

put.summary: Save the student's three onboarding answers (field, level, goal)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on title, description or category

get.summary: Visible course categories (for forms, filters and onboarding)
Suggestions from the onboarding answers (students; rule-based, no AI)
get.description: Published courses in the student's chosen fields, their level first, excluding courses they are enrolled in.

get.summary: Course detail (drafts visible to the owner and admins only)

put.summary: Update a course (owner, or admin for any course)

delete.summary: Delete a course and its enrollments (owner, or admin)

get.summary: Students enrolled in a course (owner, or admin)

patch.summary: Mark one of your enrollments completed

post.summary: Grounded course recommendations (students and guests; rate-limited)
post.description: Open to guests (5 requests / 15 min per IP) and students (10 / 15 min). Signed-in students also get their onboarding answers added as context. The published catalog is retrieved first and the model may only choose from it. Every returned id is re-validated against the database before it reaches the client.

prompt.example: I want to be a software engineer, what courses should I follow?

patch.summary: Suspend or reactivate a user (strictly lower role only; suspension is instant)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on title, description or category

patch.summary: Publish, unpublish (draft) or archive any course

delete.summary: Delete any course and its enrollments

get.summary: All categories, hidden ones included, with course counts

patch.summary: Rename (courses and student interests follow) or hide/show a category
Change a user's role (never to superadmin); ends their sessions
